subject: Hosted API deep-dive: SDK & streaming + tool-calling - availability and agenda
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Barnes <anna@carebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API deep-dive: SDK & streaming + tool-calling - availability and agenda

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the quick sync on Friday. We heard you: you want a focused, engineering-level session to validate integration approach (SDK usage, streaming behavior, and tool/function calling patterns) before the pilot kickoff.

Proposed format (45–60m):
- 10m: introductions & objectives (who owns what at CareBridge)
- 25–35m: technical deep-dive (SDK integration patterns, streaming/cancellation semantics, KV/cache behavior, auth/KMS, and tool/function calling design)
- 10m: open questions & next steps (rollout plan, sandbox access, perf targets)

Attachments: agenda.pdf (first-pass agenda + proposed code snippets).

Can you share 3 slots that work for your engineering & devops team next week? We’re available (PST): Tue 11/17 10:00–12:00, Wed 11/18 13:00–17:00, Fri 11/20 09:00–12:00. If none work, we can push to the following week.

Goal we want from the session: agree on the integration pattern (SDK vs direct REST for streaming), set latency and token-usage expectations for the pilot, and confirm sandbox credentials + sample payloads.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Anna Barnes <anna@carebridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@carebridge.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API deep-dive: SDK & streaming + tool-calling - availability and agenda

Thanks Soojin — this looks great.

We can do a 45-minute deep-dive. Proposed attendees from our side: myself (platform), Marco (backend), and our DevOps alias (devops@carebridge.com).

Our preference: Fri 11/20 09:30–10:15 PST. If you need a slightly longer slot we can do 10:30–11:15 as backup.

A couple of asks for the agenda: please include a short section on expected token billing patterns for streaming calls (we want to estimate run rates) and any recommended metrics to capture (latency p95, tokens-per-request). Attached a short requirements doc (CareBridge_integration_requirements.docx) with our auth/KMS constraints.

Thanks — Anna

--
Anna Barnes
Platform Engineering Lead | CareBridge Systems
anna@carebridge.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Barnes <anna@carebridge.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API deep-dive: SDK & streaming + tool-calling - availability and agenda

Anna / team —

Fri 11/20 09:30 PST works for us. I’ll loop Monica from Solutions Ops to cover the rollout checklist (sandbox creds, service account mapping, and log/trace access).

Note: I updated the agenda in Drive with a short sequence diagram showing the streaming path (link in related_links). We should call out:
- auth flow (short-lived keys vs mTLS)
- streaming cancellation semantics (client vs server-initiated)
- recommended backpressure approach for high-throughput endpoints

If you want us to demo a quick SDK streaming snippet, we can prepare a 5-minute code walkthrough — let us know if you prefer Python or Node.

—Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Barnes <anna@carebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API deep-dive: SDK & streaming + tool-calling - availability and agenda

Thanks all — confirming Fri 11/20 09:30–10:15 PST.

Quick logistics and pre-reads:
- We’ll demo Node SDK streaming + the equivalent REST streaming pattern (5m). If you prefer Python instead, reply-all and we’ll swap.
- Attached: sequence-diagram.png and the updated agenda (agenda.pdf).
- Per your request, we’ll include a short token billing explainer and recommended telemetry to capture (we’ll share a template you can drop into your observability dashboards).

Meeting link will be the Google Meet in the calendar invite. We’ll also create a sandbox API key scoped to a CareBridge namespace and add sample payloads before the meeting.

If Marco or DevOps have specific trace IDs / logs they want us to look at during the call, drop them in this thread and we’ll review live.

Looking forward to it — see you Friday.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Where: Google Meet (details in calendar)
Organizer: Soojin Lee (Redwood Inference)
Agenda (short):
- Intros & success metrics (5m)
- SDK streaming demo (Node) + REST streaming mapping (10m)

RSVPs: Anna Barnes (accepted), Marco (tentative), devops@carebridge.com (accepted), Soojin Lee (accepted), Marissa Cole (accepted), Rishi Malhotra (accepted), Monica Patel (accepted)
